gloss: kitchen counter; cooking counter; food preparation surface

definitions.gloss: kitchen counter; cooking counter; food preparation surface
definitions.explanation: A flat work surface in a kitchen used for preparing and assembling food. In professional kitchens, it may refer to a dedicated preparation station.

examples.japanese: {調理台|ちょうりだい}を{拭|ふ}く。
{食材|しょくざい}を{調理台|ちょうりだい}の{上|うえ}に{並|なら}べた。
examples.english: I lined up the ingredients on the kitchen counter.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいキッチンには{広|ひろ}い{調理台|ちょうりだい}があるので、{料理|りょうり}がしやすい。
examples.english: The new kitchen has a spacious counter, so it's easy to cook.

notes:
Combines {調理|ちょうり} (cooking, food preparation) and {台|だい} (stand, counter, platform). Used in both home and professional kitchen contexts. In apartment listings and kitchen showrooms, {調理台|ちょうりだい} specifically refers to the countertop workspace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理台|ちょうりだい}の{上|うえ}: on the counter
- {調理台|ちょうりだい}を{清潔|せいけつ}にする: to keep the counter clean
- ステンレス{製|せい}の{調理台|ちょうりだい}: stainless steel preparation counter
- {調理台|ちょうりだい}の{高|たか}さ: counter height

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カウンター: counter — often used for a bar-style counter or service counter, not specifically for food preparation
- {作業台|さぎょうだい}: work table — general-purpose work surface, not limited to kitchens
- まな{板|いた}: cutting board — the board placed on the counter for cutting food
